:::{#def-epigraph}
#### Epigraph

The **epigraph**
[@wikipedia_epigraph_mathematics]
of $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ is the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) of points on or over its [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph),

$$
\operatorname{epi} f \eqdef \cb{(\vx, s) : \vx \in \reals^p,\ s \in \reals,\ f(\vx) \le s}.
$$

A pair $(\vx, s)$ is treated as the $(p + 1)$-vector with entries $x_1, \ldots, x_p, s$,
so $\operatorname{epi} f \subseteq \reals^{p+1}$,
and sums and multiples of pairs are taken entry by entry.

:::
